name: claude-devohmycode-mods
description: Function-hook mods for Claude Code: a tabbed pane beside the transcript, and the messages other sessions send, held out of the context until you say otherwise.

plugins.name: cockpit
plugins.description: One pane of tabs beside the transcript, and the $.cockpit noun other plugins fill: the session's context, cost and models, what it spent and what the plan has left, the prompts this machine has typed, the files Claude touched, the tools it called and the subagents it started.

plugins.name: message
plugins.description: What another session sends lands in a tab instead of in the context: session.receive turns the delivery away before it costs a token, the thread lives in a mailbox on disk, and a field answers through SendMessage without starting a model turn.
